content:
“Brace for impact!”

**Blocker** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Take less damage from your opponents' melee attacks.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Block 25% more damage from your opponents' melee attacks. | 003D2953 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Block 20% more damage from your opponents' melee attacks. | 003D2952 | 
| ★ | 1 | Block 15% more damage from your opponents' melee attacks. | 003D2950 | 

- This perk does not require actively blocking with a melee weapon, nor does it require holding one, rather, it acts passively so long as the perk card is equipped, even while wearing power armor.
- Like all % damage reduction effects, Blocker will be applied after DR reduction.
- Blocker will stack multiplicatively with other % damage reduction effects, like Dodgy or power armor set bonus.
